run_voc_clip_name: run the voc_clip_name module to generate CLIP text embeddings for VOC categories
run_voc_clip_name_prompt_a: run the voc_clip_name module with prompt 'a' to generate text features for 20 VOC classes
run_voc_clip_name_prompt_photo: run the voc_clip_name module with prompt 'photo' to generate text features using photo-style prompts
run_voc_clip_name_custom_output: run the voc_clip_name module with a custom output path to save CLIP text embeddings as numpy file
run_voc_clip_name_clip_model: run the voc_clip_name module with a custom CLIP model to encode VOC category text features
